note:
Header banner for /pages/ingredients, replacing the unbranded stock frame (three generic dropper bottles on white) with our own range.

SOURCE: banner-ingredients-range-graphite wave, slot A (row of three, type zone left), nbp_pro candidate 1 — one of the candidates that came back clean on ALL THREE labels at full resolution. Class A: PDRN Skin Repair (rose-pink), Copper Peptide (deep blue) and Glutathione (frosted white), every line quoted verbatim from the product configs.

CANVAS EXTENDED 1995 -> 3750x848 (4.42:1), past the 4.36:1 a 100vw x 440px box reaches at a 1920 viewport, so full height survives there. The header keeps the theme's standard sm height.

EDGE FRINGE TRIMMED, which is a new one worth recording. The generated frame carried a bright fringe on its first few columns — 38.8, 37.0, 34.7 against a settled 33.2 — and that matters more than it looks, because the edge profile averages the first columns AND the join correction anchors to column 0 exactly. The fringe was therefore both smeared across the whole 1755px fill and pinned at the seam, drawing a visible vertical edge down the join. Trimming four columns first drops the join to 0.67 levels against a 0.74 reference.

TEXT MOVES OFF CENTRE to the left, into the zone the brief held clear, matching every other banner published this week. Overlay drops 40 -> 25: the shot is already dark and 40 was flattening the bottles.
